Risk Description: Ransomware exposure on legacy public-facing Apache web server running outdated software versions.
Mitigation Strategy / Action Item: Isolate server inside an internal DMZ segment; patch Apache daemon to current stable baseline release; deploy endpoint protection agents.

Risk Description: Data exfiltration threat via missing multi-factor authentication (MFA) parameters on internal engineering VPN access portals.
Mitigation Strategy / Action Item: Enforce absolute strict phishing-resistant MFA tokens globally via enterprise IDP integration configurations.

Risk Description: Privilege creeping threat leading to unauthorized engineering staff maintaining local admin rights on high-value corporate backup nodes.
Mitigation Strategy / Action Item: Enforce strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC); run automated quarterly privilege audits; configure automated session timeouts.
